status.emailEvidence: VERIFIED - OWNER EVIDENCE, 2026-09-26. Two independent owner-confirmed receipts into hello@apexhospitalitygrouplv.org (Namecheap Private Email, MX mx1/mx2.privateemail.com): (1) a normal Gmail message sent directly to the address, which arrived; (2) the live production Web3Forms form notification, which arrived. The mailbox is real, active and readable. NOT tested by the agent - Private Email cannot be read from this session and SMTP ports 25/465/587 are blocked, so mailbox existence could never be probed here. Supersedes the earlier UNVERIFIED note. The '554 5.7.1 Relay access denied' bounce dated 2026-09-13 belongs to hello@apexcontentstudio.online - the RETIRED domain on free forwarding - and never applied to this address.
status.httpsEvidence: 2026-09-24 against Vercel's certificate store, not a browser padlock check. Certificate cert_qGQRlrI7ibAfGPB8mQQCoPq9, common name apexhospitalitygrouplv.org, issued 2026-09-15, expires 2026-12-14, autoRenew true. Vercel serves aliases over HTTPS only and the domain is aliased to the current READY production deployment. Scope: the certificate covers the apex only, www is not a subject of it. A direct handshake from this session proves nothing, because the egress gateway re-terminates TLS and presents its own certificate (issuer 'Anthropic / Egress Gateway SDS Issuing CA'); an HTTP request through it returns 403 host_not_allowed. An owner browser padlock check is still the only end-to-end confirmation.
status.formSubmissionEvidence: VERIFIED - OWNER EVIDENCE, 2026-09-26. NOT tested by the agent: this session's egress gateway returns HTTP 000 for every external host (example.com and google.com included), so no live submission was made or attempted here. The owner changed the Web3Forms Email Configuration on the form 'My First APEX Content Studio' to hello@apexhospitalitygrouplv.org, confirmed that address shows as a VERIFIED linked email in Web3Forms, then submitted ONE live production form submission and confirmed the notification arrived in that mailbox. Chain proven end to end: production site -> production form -> api.web3forms.com -> production access key -> hello@apexhospitalitygrouplv.org -> readable business mailbox. Agent-side corroboration: the form posts JSON to https://api.web3forms.com/submit with a 36-char access key and NO recipient-routing field of any kind, so routing is controlled entirely by the Web3Forms dashboard - which is why the dashboard change alone was sufficient and no code change was needed.
